6553-8095-8207.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

586-4247-5258-5618-6580.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7727.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

240-4247-4359-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

254-301-2813.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
254-301-2813.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat from step 2

3532-5078-5705-7742.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5705-7742.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Machinesmith Automaton triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Machinesmith Automaton.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

240-4050-5223-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1526-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
1526-7282-7340.description:
Activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Circle of Dreams Druid.
Repeat.

252-1575-2438-5776.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
252-1575-2438-5776.notes: The combo can instead by started by sacrificing an untapped noncreature Food to its own ability. This will replace step 1 for the first iteration and add {2} to the mana needed. After the first iteration, follow the steps above as normal.

851-1563-2457-4460.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2034-2279-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3000-3899-7060.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3534-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-3534-6157.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
1479-2841-3534-6157.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Field of the Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Field of the Dead trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Field of the Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1477-3652-4053-6989.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

225-774-2232.easyPrerequisites: You have a mana-producing land on the battlefield or in your hand.
225-774-2232.notablePrerequisites: You have two nonartifact land cards in hand.
225-774-2232.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two nonartifact lands from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Cloudstone Curio trigger twice.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a mana-producing land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 3 for the other Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve both Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the lands from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

1781-1978-3717.description:
Cause Viridian Joiner to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Viridian Joiner.
Repeat from step 2.

850-1978-2750.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
850-1978-2750.description:
Cause Overgrown Battlement to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2034-4094-5220-5632-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-4094-5220-5632-6961.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating two creature tokens and two Clue tokens
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 2.

1734-6132-6798.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1350-2793-5226-6871.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph triggers, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact land creature.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Toph triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1563-1879-2457-6441.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2196-2701-3277.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1170-2196-2701-3277.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

1491-2313-4289-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
1491-2313-4289-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
1491-2313-4289-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

183-1624-3625-3646.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{W}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
183-1624-3625-3646.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
183-1624-3625-3646.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Storvald either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become 1.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

523-3263-3851.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of Selves attached to Hellkite Tyrant.
Opponents are unable to block and kill creatures you control.
There are at least twenty permanents on the battlefield.
Hellkite Tyrant does not have summoning sickness.
523-3263-3851.description:
Declare Hellkite Tyrant as an attacker.
Hellkite Tyrant's myriad ability triggers, creating a token copy of it attacking each other opponent.
Deal combat damage with each Hellkite Tyrant.
Each Hellkite Tyrant's ability triggers, causing you to gain control of all permanents your opponent control, as they are all artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Hellkite Tyrant triggers, causing you to win the game.

372-4013.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanent card(s) you own that can produce at least {3}{C} exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian's enters-the-battlefield ability.
Holding priority, activate the nonland mana-producing permanent(s) by tapping them, adding at least {3}{C}.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the nonland mana-producing permanent(s) and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

476-4050-4735.description:
Cast Crafty Cutpurse by paying {3}{U}.
Crafty Cutpurse enters the battlefield, causing all tokens that would be created under an opponent's control this turn to be created under your control instead.
Activate Questing Phelddagrif's first ability by paying {G}, causing Questing Phelddagrif to get +1/+1 until end of turn and creating a 1/1 Hippo creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Hippo token, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 3.

600-1180-4329.notablePrerequisites: Nicol Bolas has at least five loyalty counters on it.
600-1180-4329.description:
Activate Nicol Bolas using Jace's third loyalty ability by removing five loyalty counters from it, creating two copies of Nicol Bolas that enter with five loyalty counters each.
Repeat using a Nicol Bolas token instead.
